Audio credits

Bird ambience: “Park ambiences” by Thimras, CC0 1.0. https://opengameart.org/content/park-ambiences . Adapted to a 4-second MP3 excerpt with an ending fade.

Bow release: “Battle Sound Effects” by artisticdude (submitted by Ogrebane), CC0 1.0. https://opengameart.org/content/battle-sound-effects . Unmodified audio.

Pig grunts: “Farm animals” / Mudchute pig recordings by Secretlondon, submitted by qubodup. https://opengameart.org/content/farm-animals . CC BY-SA 3.0 or later: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/ . Unmodified audio. Original author: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/User:Secretlondon . These are recordings of domestic pigs, used as animal effects.
